en.p: When a function $f(x)$ continuous on the set of all real numbers and a cubic function $g(x)$ with leading coefficient 1 satisfy
which of the statements in <Statements> are correct? [4 points]

box: b. The function $f(x)$ has a local maximum value.
c. When $2<f(1)<4$, the number of distinct real roots of the equation $f(x)=x$ is 3.
